result.title: ExQuery: Explicit Structured Query Priors for Temporal 3D Object Detection
result.summary: Sparse query-based 3D detectors commonly encode heterogeneous semantic, geometric, and motion information into unified latent queries, including when explicit 3D anchors are used. We introduce ExQuery, an explicit structured query framework for temporal 3D object detection. Each decoded query is organized into a shared semantic context slice and physical-state-specific slices for center, dimensions, orientation, and velocity. This structure is preserved from prior encoding to branch-specific regression and is reused to reconstruct temporal queries: predicted physical states are transformed by ego motion, classification scores form soft semantic priors, and the reconstructed query is fused with the stored latent instance feature through gated affine modulation. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that our method achieves competitive detection performance, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our proposed modules.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ExQuery，将每个解码 query 拆成共享语义切片与中心、尺寸、朝向、速度等物理状态切片，并在回归分支与由预测状态、分类软先验重建的时序 query 中保持该结构，用门控仿射调制与已存 latent 实例特征融合，在 nuScenes 上验证检测性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化切片 latent + 门控调制融合重建先验」的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态如何分块承载任务必要信息、以及新证据与缓存 latent 的筛选融合问题相通，可供核查；但该文为纯 3D 检测、无语言推理，迁移属推测。
